enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +15: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Quality Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Dexterity.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Insightful Reflex Save +6: This item gives a +6 Insight bonus to your Reflex saves.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
